name: list_secrets
description: List the secrets of this org with each name, environmentVariable, description, and availability. Call before you ask a member for an API key, a token, or another credential. Use run_with_secrets for each command that needs a secret. Read each value through its environmentVariable. Needs only the workspace token. An active turn adds its session approvals to availability. Never returns values. Keep secret values out of output, files, and answers.

name: run_with_secrets
description: Run a shell command on this cloud computer with named secrets in its environment. Use for each command that needs a secret. Call list_secrets before you ask a member for an API key, a token, or another credential. Needs an active calling turn. Acts for the member whose message started that turn. Uses approved secrets with no request. Requests approval when needed and waits up to 90 seconds. A pending result ends without a command. After a late-answer notice, call again. Read each value through the environmentVariable from list_secrets. Two names that need one environment key fail before any request. Run those names separately. Returns filtered stdout, stderr, exitCode, and the environmentVariables name-to-variable map. Keep each value out of output, files, and answers. The filter hides only exact copies.

names.description: One or more secret names. A missing name asks a member for a temporary value.

command.description: Shell command to run with /bin/sh in this workspace. The request shows this text as the command you say you will run. Read values from the environment. Never put a value in this text.

reason.description: Why this command needs the named secrets.

name: run_mac_command
description: Ask to run a command when the task needs the member's Mac. Needs an active calling turn. The request goes to the Mac of the member whose message started the turn. The Mac app asks before each command, unless a permission that its user chose there covers it.

name: create_workspace
description: Create a workspace with this workspace's owner and start its first message. Needs an active calling turn. Acts for the member whose message started that turn. Omitted model and effort use the owner's defaults. An omitted section uses the default section. startBranch creates the workspace branch from that branch. baseBranch sets the pull request target and Changes comparison branch. If both branches are omitted, both use the repository default branch. If only one branch is given, both use that branch. Fast mode requires explicit fast: true for a marked model. The reply gives the workspace number and link, and the first session link. These calls reach workspaces in this org. An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. Workspace and session links show as chips. A session link holds both IDs. A Sent by: line names the sending session. Do not reply only to confirm it. Pass parentId to nest the new workspace. Nest work that belongs to the calling workspace's task: a part of a large task that can run in parallel, follow-up work that the task starts, work in another repository for the same task, or a change that needs its own pull request. Each separate pull request needs its own workspace. Omit parentId for unrelated work. When a member names the place, follow the member. Agents usually pass their own workspace ID from their instructions. The new workspace joins its parent's section, so sectionId has no effect with parentId. Nesting stops at depth 3. A create under a workspace at depth 3 fails with nesting_limit. Its message gives the parentId for a sibling. Start the sibling's name with a one-word group prefix, such as "Limits: ". The workspace in the reply gives parentId. The reply can give a notice about its section.

startBranch.description: Create the workspace branch from this branch. Omission uses baseBranch, or the repository default when both branches are omitted.

baseBranch.description: Use this branch for the pull request target and Changes comparison. Omission uses startBranch, or the repository default when both branches are omitted.

name.description: Optional workspace name. Use plain words separated by spaces. Avoid underscores unless the user tells you to add them. The app keeps the first line, without a final full stop, cut to 60 characters at a word.

firstSessionTitle.description: Optional first session title. Use plain words separated by spaces. Avoid underscores unless the user tells you to add them.

sectionId.description: A section ID from list_sections. Omission uses the default section. With parentId, the new workspace joins its parent's section.

requestId.description: Keep this ID to retry without another workspace, session, or message. Omission generates an ID.

fast.description: Use fast mode for a marked model. Creates default to false. Omission on send keeps the session speed.

parentId.description: Parent workspace ID. Agents usually pass their own workspace ID from their instructions. Omission makes a top-level workspace.

name: list_workspaces
description: List workspaces with their number, link, name, branch, state, and owner ID, login, and display name. Needs only the workspace token. Without filters or paging, returns every workspace that is not removed, including archives. Set removed true to list only removed workspaces. Each filter must match. Use the actual message sender's member ID for their workspaces. Find another owner's ID in returned owner fields. Do not infer the owner from the token or active turn. These calls reach workspaces in this org. An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. Workspace and session links show as chips. A session link holds both IDs. A Sent by: line names the sending session. Do not reply only to confirm it. Each entry gives parentId, or null for a top-level workspace. Pass parentId to list only the direct sub-workspaces of that workspace.

ownerId.description: A stable member ID from the actual message Sender line or workspace owner fields. A login is not an ID.

updatedSince.description: Signed safe-integer epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Select newer activity.

archived.description: Select archived workspaces with true, or other workspaces with false. Removed workspaces need removed true.

removed.description: Select only removed workspaces with true. False or omission leaves them out.

limit.description: Maximum entries. A limited reply gives hasMore. Omission returns every entry.

offset.description: Entries to skip before the next page.

parentId.description: Parent workspace ID. List only its direct sub-workspaces. An unknown ID gives an empty list.

name: get_workspace
description: Get workspace details, including owner, repository, base branch, section, activity, archive, restore, and removal times. Reads removed workspaces too. Needs only the workspace token. These calls reach workspaces in this org. An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. Workspace and session links show as chips. A session link holds both IDs. A Sent by: line names the sending session. Do not reply only to confirm it. The reply gives parentId, parent, depth, and children. The parent is a list entry or null. Children are direct sub-workspaces, oldest first, including archived ones.

workspaceId.description: A workspace ID from list_workspaces or a returned link. Defaults to the calling workspace.

name: move_workspace
description: Move a workspace tree to an org section, under a parent, or to the top level. Needs an active calling turn. Acts for the member whose message started that turn. These calls reach workspaces in this org. An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. Workspace and session links show as chips. A session link holds both IDs. A Sent by: line names the sending session. Do not reply only to confirm it. Pass parentId to nest the whole tree under that parent, or topLevel: true to take it out of its tree. Use only one target. A section is required without a target. A nest joins the parent's shown section. A different sectionId gives a notice. At the top level, the tree goes first in the named or shown section. A target equal to the current place changes nothing. Loops and moves past depth 3 are refused without changes. A section-only move of a nested row moves nothing. Its notice names the top-level workspace to move.

workspaceId.description: A workspace ID from list_workspaces or a returned link. Defaults to the calling workspace.

sectionId.description: A section ID from list_sections. Required without a target. A parent target uses the parent's shown section.

parentId.description: A workspace ID from list_workspaces or get_workspace. Nest the moved tree under this parent. Do not combine with topLevel: true.

topLevel.description: Use true to take the moved tree to the top level. Do not combine with parentId. False gives no target.

An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. Workspace and session links show as chips. A session link holds both IDs. A first message can queue a workspace start. The reply keeps acceptance and reports resume status. These calls reach workspaces in this org. An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. Workspace and session links show as chips. A session link holds both IDs. A Sent by: line names the sending session. Do not reply only to confirm it.

name: watch_session
description: Wake the calling session once when one watched turn finishes, fails, or stops. Needs an active calling turn. Acts for the member whose message started that turn. These calls reach workspaces in this org. An omitted workspaceId names the calling workspace. Use names and returned links in normal answers. Workspace and session links show as chips. A session link holds both IDs. Use the actual session and exact turnId returned by send_message, create_session, or create_workspace when available. Without turnId, watches current queued, running, or stopping work, or returns idle. An ended exact turn returns finished, failed, or stopped without a watch or wake. Repeated calls for the same calling session, member, target turn, and valid Stop period return the same watchId. Only the exact active calling turn is refused with invalid_input. Set the watch, then end your reply when only watched work remains. After a wake, use read_session for the result. An idle or ended reply means read the session at once. A turn end does not mean the whole delegated task is complete. Explicit Stop of the calling session drops older pending wakes. Automatic idle computer stops keep watches. Delivery uses the usual current member and session login checks. A new wake turn acts for the member who set the watch. A wake that joins a running turn keeps that turn's sender.
